name: spotlight-card1
blurb: Bento grid of dashboard cards with spotlight effects.
description: A multi-card bento layout using Spotlight and SpotLightItem components. Cards show charts/stats with varying grid spans. Dark background with gradient overlays.
use_when: Dashboard layouts or analytics showcases where bento arrangement and spotlight effects create premium data visualization experience.
avoid_when: Text-heavy content where spotlight effects could distract from data readability.
a11y: Cards are semantic containers; images and text are readable. Spotlight effects are visual embellishment.
